primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: ORR was defined as the percentage of participants who experienced a best overall response (BOR) of complete response (CR; disappearance of all target lesions) or partial response (PR; at least a 30% decrease in the sum of diameters of target lesions) and was assessed using Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (RECIST) v1.1 by IRF. 95% confidence interval (CI) was calculated by the exact binomial (Clopper-Pearson) method.

groups.description: Participants enrolled as part of AIM-HN received tipifarnib administered with food at a starting dose of 600 mg, orally, bid on Days 1-7 and 15-21 of 28-day cycles.
groups.title: Tipifarnib Treatment Cohort: AIM-HN

primaryOutcomeMeasures.populationDescription: mITT Analysis Set: consisted of all participants who received at least one dose of tipifarnib. Analysis was pre-specified for participants with high VAF only. Data collection and analysis of ORR for participants in the Observational SEQ-HN Cohort was not pre-specified.
primaryOutcomeMeasures.title: Objective Response Rate (ORR) in High Variable Allele Frequency (VAF) Population, as Assessed by Independent Review Facility (IRF)
